annotations.title: Where this server's data comes from

description: Where this server's data comes from and how far to trust it. For each kind of data: who publishes it and a link, whether it is an official record (only data its publisher published and BetaNYC did not modify is; data BetaNYC modified or produced is not), how it was gathered, what BetaNYC did to it (for example cleaned it, matched it to addresses, joined it with other data, or counted it), how current it is on this server, what it covers and what is missing, the terms of use and the credit line to print, where to check a figure at the official record, where to report an error (to BetaNYC when BetaNYC modified or produced the data, to the publisher for the original records, and to this server's issues for a bug), which tools use it, and corrections that touched it. Call it whenever someone asks where an answer comes from, how current or accurate it is, or how to check or cite it. topic narrows it to one kind of data, or to the data behind one tool (give the tool's name). For who built this server, use about_betanyc. Topics on this server: expense-disclosure, council-capital-workbook, wayback-copies, council-capital-open-data, fy2018-capital-book, pdf-tables, agency-budgets, omb-capital-budget, capital-plan, cpdb-commitments, cpdb-projects, member-crosswalk.

topic.description: One kind of data (a source id), or a tool name for the data behind that tool. Any case. Default: all.

name: about_data

contact_email.description: BetaNYC's monitored address for questions and error reports about this data, from DATA-SOURCES.json. Null when the file names none yet

left_out.description: Sources in the file that this server cannot show, and why

as_of.description: How current this data is on this server

as_of_status.description: read: a checked date from this server. unavailable: none given. unreadable: given, but not a usable date

figures_official.description: True only when the source is official and BetaNYC did not modify it. False means this copy is not the official record, because BetaNYC modified it or produced it

official.description: The source is an official publisher's record (false: BetaNYC produced it)

in_the_data.description: The publisher's page for data errors

in_the_data_handled_by.description: Who fixes errors at in_the_data: the publisher, or BetaNYC when the route is BetaNYC's own

in_the_data_name.description: Who handles reports at in_the_data: the publisher, the organization named in the file when someone else runs the route (for example a city's open data team), or BetaNYC

in_these_figures.description: When BetaNYC modified or produced the data: where to report an error in it to BetaNYC (this server's issues). Null for data its publisher published and BetaNYC did not modify

who_built_this.description: Call about_betanyc for who built this server
